title: Slow learner
desc: Doesn't catch on to new concepts very quickly.

title: Brawler
desc: Refuses to fight with anything but a melee weapon.

title: Foodie
desc: Lives to cook, and eats more than their share.

title: Wimp
desc: <name> can't handle much more than a papercut.

title: Precise
desc: Works at a slower pace, but produces higher quality work.

title: Sloppy
desc: Works at a faster pace, but produces lower quality work.

title: Storyteller
desc: <name> loves using their imagination, but doesn't like doing much else.

title: Hard worker
desc: <name> has a strong work ethic. They will work faster than average.

title: Lazy
desc: <name> can never be bothered to do more than the bare minimum. They will slack off and work slower than average.

title: Night Owl
desc: <name> prefers the cover of night. They are unaffected by the penalties of darkness, and actually rejoice in it.

title: Pyromaniac
desc: Later, fires lift the mood, a cold camp drags it down, and a break may start a fire.

title: Man-eater
desc: Later, human corpses and flesh do not sour the mood.

title: Austere
desc: Later, living conditions do not move the mood.

title: Murderous
desc: Later, a kill lifts the mood, and too long without one ends in a break.
